Who Does the Farming

Managed.

The question every buyer asks quietly: what happens to my land when I am away for three months? Here, the farm team plants, waters, prunes and harvests all seven days. You arrive on Saturday to a farm that never noticed you were gone.

Air

The city averages PM2.5 near 50. The forest does not.

Water

Natural streams, and harvesting on every estate

Earth

Living soil under your feet, not concrete

Fire

A cooler microclimate, warmth only by the fire pit

Space

Thousands of square yards that are only yours

Questions Buyers Ask

Answered before the call.

How far is it, really?

About 2 hours from Hyderabad by road, 130 km from the city and 92 km from Medchal. The nearest railway station is 7 km from the gate. The distance is exactly what keeps 25,000 protected acres on your boundary.

What does it cost?

Pricing starts from ₹70 lakhs, with estates of 2,057 and 3,630 sq yds. The complete price sheet is sent to you on WhatsApp, nothing is held back for the sales call.

What do I own, legally?

A registered forest estate inside the 160 acre gated community, with clear title. Title and land documents are shared with you before you commit, and you are encouraged to verify them with your own advocate.

Who maintains my land when I am not there?

A resident farm team plants, waters, prunes and maintains every estate through the year, including its 450+ fruit and timber trees. You own the land, they keep it alive between your visits.

What are the revenue plans for owners?

Plans for owner revenue streams are in the works. They are presented to all 132 owners together after the community closes, and stay in that room until then. Booking an estate is the way in.

Can I sell later?

Yes. Registered land with clear title resells like any land. A planted, managed estate inside a closed 132 estate community with a protected forest boundary is what protects the price when you do.

Will someone pressure me to buy at the visit?

No. The visit is hosted and complimentary for serious buyers, and nobody walks behind you with a pitch. You see the estates, the plantation and the forest at your own pace, ask what you want, and leave with the numbers. If the place takes you, you book. If not, you had a Saturday in a forest.

Can I see it before deciding?

Yes, and you should. Site visits run on Saturdays and Sundays only, hosted by the farm team, and pre-booking is mandatory so your day is properly arranged. If you are abroad or short on time, start with a video walkthrough on WhatsApp.
